title: Automated Agentic Validation of Synthetic Tabular Data
summary: A bachelor's thesis prototype that uses an LLM agentic pipeline to automatically validate synthetic tabular data against statistical and privacy criteria. It wraps SDMetrics functions (KSComplement, CorrelationSimilarity, StatisticSimilarity) as validation tools and uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to generate baseline synthetic datasets for evaluation.
